annotations.title: DOTS, IPF GL and Wilks calculator

description: Score a powerlifting total (or a bench press) against bodyweight with DOTS, IPF GL points and the original Wilks, using the coefficients the OpenPowerlifting rankings use.

equipment.description: For IPF GL: raw (classic) or equipped.

event.description: For IPF GL: sbd (full powerlifting total) or bench (bench press only).

sex.description: The formulas have separate male and female coefficients.

total.description: Total lifted (squat + bench + deadlift), or the bench press for event "bench".

unit.description: Weight unit for every load in and out: kg or lb.

name: powerlifting_score
